Key points
• Undernutrition is associated with increased severity of TB disease and poorer treatment outcomes
• Nutritional support, once the mainstay of TB treatment, is being increasingly recognized as an important adjunct to
pharmacological therapy
• Nutritional support may improve adherence to TB therapy and promote treatment completion
• Micronutrient supplementation may accelerate clinical improvement and, in HIV-coinfected individuals, has improved
treatment outcomes
Glossary
Tuberculosis (TB) An infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis which usually affects the lungs, but can be found
elsewhere (extrapulmonary disease)
Antimicrobial drug resistance The inability of a drug to kill or slow the growth of a microbe due to genetic mutations in the
microbe
